exposure: Maternal exposure windows (5, 10, 15, 30, 60, and 90 days prior to delivery)
cohort: 3671 newborns from mothers living in São José dos Campos (SP) in 2016, who had been exposed to benzene and toluene
finding: Maternal exposure to benzene and toluene in the five days prior to delivery was significantly associated with preterm delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean births were excluded from the analysis examining the association between exposure to benzene and toluene and preterm delivery.
